title: Student roster
statementMd:
List every student's name and grade level.

Expected columns: `name`, `grade_level`.

Tables: `teachers`, `courses`, `students`, `enrollments`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT name, grade_level FROM students;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
